en: Editable inputs are mapped through the template parameter schema and preset to its existing animation project.
The declared duration policy follows the current content; the package plan determines final timing.
zh: 通过模板参数和预设，将本期文字、数据或素材映射到已有动画工程。
已声明时长随本期内容适配，最终节奏由包内制作计划确定。

title.zh: 发布会舞台 · 产品演示

summary.en: Present a product on a keynote-style stage with large screens for launches and feature announcements.
summary.zh: 以发布会舞台和大屏展示组织产品演示，适合新品介绍、功能发布与品牌展示。

subtitle.zh: 发布会舞台 · 产品演示

materials.en: Your topic, script and facts to preserve.
materials.zh: 本期主题、文稿与需要准确保留的信息。

materials.en: The current voice recording or your narration preference for this production.
materials.zh: 本期配音文件，或是否需要配音的安排。

materials.en: A licensed music track or your preference for music in this production.
materials.zh: 本期已授权配乐，或本期是否需要配乐的偏好。

materials.en: Current product images, screenshots or display materials supported by the selected media slots.
materials.zh: 本期产品图片、截图或展示素材，按所选槽位支持的类型准备。

materials.en: Your current video clips for the selected scenes or declared media slots. Follow the template's separate source-audio instructions.
materials.zh: 本期视频片段，按所选场景或声明素材槽位使用；原声按模板的独立音频说明处理。

dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.
dependencies.zh: 模板声明使用 Python 和 Node.js。具体工具与版本以下载包为准。

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.
dependencies.zh: 按下载包的依赖锁和 setup/check 说明检查已有工具，只补齐缺项，并验证预览。

en: Fixed landscape animation using the listed public text/display-data/palette slots, current narration and independently supplied licensed music.
zh: Fixed landscape animation using the listed public text/display-data/palette slots, current narration and independently supplied licensed music.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps. The public demo is 108 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Current native media and complete-scene duration choices are described precisely in CURRENT-MEDIA-CLOCK.md; unrelated engine/layout changes remain unsupported.
Unlisted whole-brand graphics, new layouts or arbitrary engine/scene logic edits. Native current media uses only the declared windows and complete-scene clock contract.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；公开样片 108 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。

capabilities.en: Optional services require a live catalog, template slot and account check before they can be confirmed.
capabilities.zh: 配套服务需核对官网实时能力、模板槽位和账号权限后才能确认。
